patch_description: Reverts the failed 3rd-parameter long-range IsingXX shell (which collapsed training accuracy to 0.81/0.77) back to the empirically best-performing 2-distinct-parameter structure: global RY (theta_ry) + global RZ (theta_z) single-qubit layers, followed by two short-range CRZ entangling shells (distance-1 ring and distance-2 skip-ring) that reuse theta_z rather than introducing a new entangling parameter. On top of that proven backbone, we add a final global RY "mixer" layer that reuses the existing theta_ry parameter (no new distinct parameter introduced) after the entangling shells, letting the circuit rotate the post-entanglement Bloch vectors into better alignment with the fixed two-qubit readout observable. This keeps n_distinct_params at 2 (matching the highest-scoring prior candidate, 0.61) while adding extra expressivity for readout alignment, which should help both average and worst-group margins without any parameter-count penalty.
